scope: Known builds of the files users supply to the builder: names, sizes, versions, SHA-256 hashes and where they come from. Metadata only; no file contents. A file that is not listed is reported as unknown and still used (see docs/KNOWN_INPUTS.md). Add a build with its source label; never remove one.

entries.name: 68040.library
entries.source: Commodore AmigaOS 3.1 (37.30), as shipped in Amiga Forever 2016 (Cloanto)
entries.notes: Commodore 68040.library 37.30, AmigaOS 3.1 original, tested with the builder. File date 1994-07-06 (hint only). Trap handling on a real 68040 not yet verified (ENGINE-FPSP-MISSING-31).

entries.name: 68060.library
entries.source: MMULib 43.1 (Thomas Richter), as shipped in Amiga Forever 2016 (Cloanto)
entries.notes: MMULib 68060.library 43.1 (Thomas Richter), not a Commodore file: shipped in that set's Libs drawer. Needs mmu.library. Tested with the builder. File date 2009-11-01 (hint only). Trap handling on a real 68060 not yet verified (ENGINE-FPSP-MISSING-31).
